data.name: Bachu
data.gender_notes: Bachu is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Bachu is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Bhagavat', meaning 'blessed one'. In Hindu mythology, this name is associated with Lord Vishnu and Lord Krishna, symbolizing divine grace and protection. The name Bachu carries the meaning “Blessed one” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bachu usually hope their child will grow to embody blessed one and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bachu total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
